notes: SWARMLERHook is deployed directly by CREATE2 with no owner, proxy, upgradeability or setters. Its constructor takes (IPoolManager manager_, address token_) in that order: $poolManager resolves to Ethereum mainnet PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90 and $token to the freshly deployed SWARMLER token. SWARMLER has no constructor arguments. Mine the hook address so its low 14 bits equal 0x20c4: beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap and afterSwapReturnDelta; all other permissions are false. Callbacks accept only PoolManager. beforeInitialize accepts only this hook's SWARMLER/IMD pool with static fee 12500 and tick spacing 60. The 1.25% LP fee is unchanged. Ordinary swaps additionally pay floor(abs(actual unspecified-currency BalanceDelta) / 100) through afterSwapReturnDelta: output currency for exact input, input currency for exact output, including partial fills. Fees accrue as hook-owned ERC-6909 claims without transfers or buybacks inside swap callbacks. Anyone may call sweep() to redeem all pending SWARMLER fees to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead. Anyone may call executeBatch() while PoolManager is locked, in a separate unlock, to spend up to 25% of pending IMD on an exact-input buyback. The reference is the pool's previous-block closing sqrtPrice, captured on the first hook touch of a new block and aged from the last price-update block; no tick or time-weighted oracle is used. The sole price bound is 300 bps in sqrtPrice in the buyback direction (reference * 1.03 when SWARMLER is currency0, reciprocal when currency1, clamped inside TickMath bounds). A reference older than 50 blocks uses the current price and half the budget. Partial fills retain unspent IMD claims; a crossed bound yields zero spend. The 3600-second cooldown starts only when actual spend reaches at least 1% of that batch's budget, rounded up. Buybacks pay the LP fee but no hook fee, and purchased SWARMLER goes directly to the dead address. Public views include pending(), pendingBurn(), lastBatch() and referencePrice(). Parameters are immutable. The token mints its entire 1e27-unit supply to its deployer; the launch factory handles distribution and derives the opening price from launch economics. pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
